#### itsual/agent-skills-collection -- 42 rejected design-ux siblings (inspected 2026-08-29)

HEAD of main pinned 8d2fd11b59496bfb3792e747e5519817e554e6cf (verified via a commit-page 200 check after the GitHub REST API rate-limited this session; stars 6, last push 2026-07-22 per github.com HTML). License: MIT at repo-root LICENSE (copyright 2026 Arockia Liborious), read in full. The repo is a 501-skill mass-generated collection across 13 domains (per its own README table); `skills/design-ux/` holds 46 skills, every one following an identical ~40-line template (Overview / When to Use / Core Practices or Principles / Verification checklist) confirmed by reading heuristic-evaluation, design-critique, design-ethics, dashboard-ux and data-visualization-ux in full, and by reading the frontmatter description of all 46 siblings. Task scope capped vendoring at 4 skills from this repo; heuristic-evaluation, design-ethics, dashboard-ux and data-visualization-ux were selected (see their own manifests) as the only siblings clearing uniqueness>=1 against the already-vendored registry -- every other sibling is either an exact or near-exact name/concept duplicate of an already-vendored, materially richer registry skill (uniqueness 0), or (design-ops, gesture-design, illustration-in-product) too thin and low-relevance to justify vendoring even without a direct duplicate. All 42 share the same clean MIT license and clean security profile as the 4 vendored siblings (single-file SKILL.md, no scripts, no network calls, no hidden instructions) -- none were rejected on license or security grounds, all on uniqueness/quality/cap grounds.
